snippet.title: Cozy BookShop Simulator Meets Fantasy RPG - My Cozy BookShop
snippet.description:
Ever wanted to run a cozy bookshop? Now you can! If it seems like a game you'd love to play then like, subscribe and follow me on my journey for making this game!

Wishlist On Steam below:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3884660/My_Cozy_BookShop/
